title: trichophorum cyperinum
intro: Trichophorum cyperinum, commonly known as Cottongrass, is a type of sedge that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems and digestive issues due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Trichophorum cyperinum include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
